Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The mistake occurred when WebSurfer initially provided the death date from Wikipedia without verification from more than one credible source. WebSurfer sourced the death date from a single source (Wikipedia) without confirming it with other authoritative sources like Britannica or museum sites, which are generally more reliable for historical data. This led to an over-reliance on a single source, contributing to the incomplete result when solving the real-world problem.
